summary.text: Shelley Aloi is the Republican candidate for Maryland State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Karen Lewis Young (D).
A former Frederick City alderman, she says her background includes work in education, research, banking and government.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Aloi said she was raised and built her career in Frederick.

She listed experience as a Frederick City alderman; vice chair of the Washington Area Council of Governments Chesapeake Bay and Water Resources Policy Committee; a banking compliance analyst; a public school teacher and university instructor; a nine-year board member of Beyond Shelter; and executive director of the Marriage Resource Center of Frederick County.

Ballotpedia also lists her as a 2014 candidate for lieutenant governor of Maryland who intended to share the Republican ticket with gubernatorial candidate Ron George, who lost the June 24, 2014 primary.

Aloi's listed campaign messages include opposing new taxes and fees on working families, pursuing a state budget that lives within its means, and seeking limits on data centers' energy use, water use, noise and pollution.
